coverage_units.unit: Sections 1–2: mathematical setting, learning target and hypotheses
coverage_units.checked: Fixed unknown dynamics, safe set, robust prior intersections, true-map prediction domain, and specialization to singleton matrix identification; distinctions between horizons and quantifiers.
coverage_units.outcome: F5 qualifies the general horizon-monotonicity assertion. Version and experiment limits retained.

coverage_units.unit: Section 3: one-step linear safety, algorithms and experiments
coverage_units.checked: Proposition 1 primal/dual signs and finite support; Lemma 7 span construction; Theorem 8 at-most-n independent information and stalled-span impossibility; Algorithm 2 affine mixing; Section 3.5 lower-bound premise and row-interior counterevidence.
coverage_units.outcome: F4 establishes one allowed singular offline mixture and a determinant-based repair; F8 records optimizer/existence qualifications. Online span argument and the displayed lower bound retain support. Original costs/figures were not rerun.

coverage_units.unit: Section 4: two-step safety and generic identification
coverage_units.checked: Theorem 10 affine trajectory constraints, singleton case, relative strict feasibility and S-lemma; Lemma 12 coordinate sampling and Proposition 14 absolute continuity; Theorem 13 odd/even determinant witnesses and ambient measure-zero qualification.
coverage_units.outcome: Core two-step reformulation and generic rank argument supported under well-defined measurable selections; F8 addresses unbounded coordinate extrema without disproving the generic existence argument.

coverage_units.unit: Section 5: infinite-horizon linear safety and learning
coverage_units.checked: Proposition 15 exact Cayley–Hamilton consistency, Proposition 16 necessary boundedness/stability context, Lemma 20 invariant ellipsoid, Lemma 24 uniform decay, Theorem 18 SOS soundness/existence at fixed degree, and Theorem 25 Krylov generic identification; distinct numerical priors checked separately.
coverage_units.outcome: F2 contradicts the printed Section 5.5.1 prior/certificate; F6 and F7 admit local repairs preserving the conditional existence theorem. Separate Frobenius-ball prior stability is positive counterevidence. No original SOS solver/experiment was run.

coverage_units.unit: Section 6: nonlinear one-step safety, disturbances and fitting
coverage_units.checked: Pointwise growth prior, Theorem 26 LP support and previously sampled states under a valid noiseless robust history; Remark 27 information conditioning with changing disturbance bounds; fitted-model prior membership and SOS sufficiency.
coverage_units.outcome: F3 disproves exact full-history conditioning for a stated changing-noise case, while preserving conservative safety and exactness for a rectangular outer model. The additive sign on physical page 40 was confirmed at original image detail; there is no missing-sign finding. Reported fitted-model errors remain unreplicated experiment-specific observations.

coverage_units.unit: Section 7: nonlinear infinite-horizon certificates and example
coverage_units.checked: Lemma 31 robust LMI, zero state, Theorem 29 uniform small-nonlinearity existence, Remark 30 valid residual bounds, and Section 7.1 dependency on the printed linear prior.
coverage_units.outcome: Positive bounded LMI/noise calculations support the signs and intended conditional theorem. F7 radius repair applies here; F2 transfers to the imported prior because zero nonlinear dynamics remain admissible. The displayed true matrix has off-diagonal sum 9/10, inconsistent with printed 9/5.

coverage_units.unit: Section 8: sparse, low-rank and permutation priors
coverage_units.checked: Theorem 32 sparse support/LP dual; Theorem 34 spectral block, dual coefficients and complete feasibility witness; Remark 36 closure under powers; Theorem 37 assignment dual and Remark 38 permutation powers.
coverage_units.outcome: F1 exhibits an unsafe feasible point for the printed low-rank program. M-squared scaling repairs the block; a direct rank-one support proof gives an exact SOCP for positive rank budget. Sparse and permutation bounded enumerations agree with their formulas.

coverage_units.checked: Definition 39 identification target; Proposition 40 joint A/B consistency dual with shared multipliers; Corollary 41 augmented dynamics on S×C and n plus control-dimension query bound.
coverage_units.outcome: Joint, rather than independent marginal, uncertainty is retained; augmentation and span argument supported subject to F8 selection qualifications.
